name: Snake Charmer
source:
Til was a young snake charmer who lived peacefully until the day when I brought a wounded snake at this place... But he didn't know that this snake was actually the prince who ran away from his kingdom...

[From [url=https://overtired-fox.itch.io/snake-charmer]itch.io[/url]
translation:
蒂尔是一位年轻的耍蛇人，一直过着平静的生活。直到某天，一条受伤的蛇被带到他这里……他并不知道，这条蛇其实是一位逃离自己王国的王子……

[摘自[url=https://overtired-fox.itch.io/snake-charmer]itch.io[/url]]
